---
title: "Shared network data: Beijing and LargeST schemas"
output: html_document
---

These small **synthetic** examples demonstrate the processed source schemas.
They are not traffic observations or model results. No models are fitted.
Both sources use the same visualization payload and plot method. Beijing has
edge observations; LargeST has sensor observations and no inferred adjacency.
Coordinates below are displayed directly without a projected basemap.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(bdynets)
```

```{r examples, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
for (source in c("beijing", "largest")) {
  x <- network_example(source)
  print(panel_long(x))
  plot(x, time_index=2)
}
```

Missing observations remain gray. Observed zeros retain their numeric value.
Color limits are computed across all frames, so switching time does not change
the scale. Synthetic timestamps use UTC; real imports should supply their
actual time zone and interval convention.

```{r session}
sessionInfo()
```
